claim_modes.rationale: Donor wording is a proposition about what legal and administrative records state.
Current custody is an administrative fact susceptible to direct institutional documentation.
Caster identity is an authorship/fabrication attribution problem; a catalog's unknown founder field does not establish historical unknowability.
The exact predecessor/recast relationship requires reconstruction across conflicting object histories.
Casting location is a historical event/location proposition, even though current support is incomplete.
Approximate recast date is a historical chronology proposition.
The 1894 commission is an administrative event that can be established from the underlying act.
Creative responsibility for development of the boceto is an authorship-role attribution.
Modeling and casting responsibility is a creative/fabrication-role attribution.
